text: Using Dijkstra's weakest-precondition calculus, what is wp(x := x + 1, x > 5)?
explanation: wp(x := E, Q) = Q[E/x], so substitute x+1 for x in (x > 5): (x+1) > 5, i.e. x > 4. To guarantee x > 5 after incrementing, you need x > 4 beforehand. Choice 2 forgets to substitute; choices 0 and 3 shift in the wrong direction.
